sections.subhead: For Ecommerce Businesses That Have Outgrown Off-the-Shelf Platforms

body.text: Teknoppy builds custom ecommerce platforms in Kochi for stores that have outgrown Shopify or WooCommerce — with bespoke checkout and pricing rules, headless storefronts, and links to your ERP, CRM and inventory systems. Most builds take 6-12 weeks and start from Rs. 2,00,000.

Choosing the right custom ecommerce development partner in Kochi matters because custom architecture must be scalable from day one — retrofitting complex pricing or catalogue logic onto the wrong foundation later is expensive and slow.

sections.h2: What Our Custom Ecommerce Development Includes
sections.intro: When standard store plugins become a limitation, we engineer dedicated commerce platforms covering five core capabilities:

items.title: Custom Platform Architecture
items.text: Custom ecommerce platform development starts with choosing the right technical foundation for your specific scale, product complexity, and growth plans — not defaulting to whatever platform is fastest to set up.

items.title: Bespoke Checkout & Product Logic
items.html: For businesses with tiered B2B pricing, custom configurators, or bespoke checkout flows. Includes seamless payment gateway integration with Razorpay, Stripe, and Cashfree.

items.title: Headless & API-First Builds
items.text: Where flexibility matters, headless ecommerce decouples the high-speed frontend from backend services, giving you full control over user experience, Core Web Vitals, and multi-channel selling.

items.title: Enterprise-Scale & B2B Builds
items.html: B2B portals with wholesale price tiers, credit terms, and ERP sync. For multi-seller platforms, see our Marketplace Development services.

sections.intro: We build custom commerce platforms using proven, modern engineering frameworks:

items.title: Modern Frontend Frameworks
items.text: Next.js, Astro, and React storefronts delivering lightning-fast sub-second page loads and superior Core Web Vitals scores.

items.title: Robust Backend & API Architecture
items.text: Node.js, Laravel, and Python APIs engineered for high-concurrency catalog queries and secure order processing.

items.title: Enterprise Databases
items.text: PostgreSQL and MySQL configured with query caching, connection pooling, and automated daily backups.

items.title: Payment & Cloud Infrastructure
items.text: Direct integrations for Razorpay, Stripe, and Cashfree, hosted on scalable AWS or Cloudflare edge networks.

sections.intro: Our custom build process is structured across five sequential stages:

items.title: Requirements & Architecture (Weeks 1-2)
items.text: We map your specific product logic, B2B pricing tiers, and ERP/CRM integration requirements into a technical specification.

items.title: Database & UX Wireframes (Weeks 3-4)
items.text: Database schemas for custom attributes and high-converting checkout wireframes are created and approved.

items.title: Storefront & API Build (Weeks 5-8)
items.text: The custom frontend, backend business logic, and third-party API connections are developed and reviewed in staging.

items.title: Integration & Security Auditing (Weeks 9-10)
items.text: End-to-end testing of payments, tax rules, courier integrations, and stress-testing under simulated traffic surges.

items.title: Migration, Launch & Handover (Weeks 11-12)
items.text: Full product data and order migration, 301 URL redirect implementation, and complete source code and documentation handover.

sections.intro: Live custom platforms engineered for distinct business models:

items.title: My PlantStore — Dubai, UAE
items.text: Custom ecommerce storefront built for a leading UAE plant nursery brand. Features 8 product categories with multi-level subcategories, customer accounts & wishlist, emirate-based delivery thresholds, and live variant pricing.

items.title: B2B Manufacturing & Wholesale Portal
items.text: B2B wholesale portal featuring custom bulk pricing tiers, dealer credit management, automated GST invoicing, and real-time ERP inventory synchronization.

items.q: When does a business actually need custom ecommerce development instead of WooCommerce or Shopify?
items.a: When product logic, checkout requirements, or integrations exceed what standard plugins or apps can handle — complex pricing rules, unusual product configurators, or connecting to internal systems no off-the-shelf integration supports.

items.q: How much does custom ecommerce development cost in Kochi?
items.a: Most custom stores and B2B commerce portals cost between Rs. 2,00,000 and Rs. 6,00,000, depending on custom pricing logic, headless storefront requirements, and ERP or CRM integrations. We provide a detailed scope and fixed quote following technical review.

items.q: Will we own the source code and store data?
items.a: Yes. 100% of the custom source code, database architectures, and cloud hosting accounts are transferred to your ownership after deployment, with zero vendor lock-in.

items.q: What is headless ecommerce, and do we need it?
items.a: Headless ecommerce separates your frontend customer-facing storefront from the backend database and order engine. It is ideal if you require sub-second mobile speeds or plan to power a web store, mobile apps, and kiosks from a single product database.

items.q: Can you move our products and orders from Shopify or WooCommerce?
items.a: Yes. We migrate your product catalog, customer accounts, and order history, while setting up comprehensive 301 redirects to ensure your established Google search rankings are completely protected.

items.q: How long does a custom ecommerce build take?
items.a: Custom builds typically take 6 to 12 weeks depending on technical complexity, accommodating database planning, custom API development, payment integration, and cross-device testing.
